Opening Hours

The garden is open from Wednesday to Sunday.

  • Weekdays (Wed–Fri): 8:30 A.M. – 7:00 P.M.
  • Weekend (Sat–Sun): 10:00 A.M. – 4:00 P.M.

*Note: The glasshouse closes 45 minutes before the garden’s closing time.

Glasshouse Access

The garden has a newly restored tropical glasshouse. Located on the second floor of the terrace, it contains a wide range of plants from three continents. While there is an entry charge of $6 per visit to cover heating costs, registered horticulture students with valid course cards are exempt from this charge. This policy is intended to help students in preparing practical coursework.

Group Visits

Guided walks are available on request. Schools and other groups planning a visit must reserve a place at least ten days in advance.
